```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries for data manipulation and visualization
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

# Load the Instacart dataset from p8105.datasets
data("instacart")

# Take a random sample of 10,000 rows to optimize dashboard performance
set.seed(123)
instacart_sample <- instacart %>% 
  sample_n(10000)
